info.title: Reelplane API
info.description: Upload short videos, have them transcoded to an HLS ladder, and serve them as feeds. Every response is JSON. Errors look like `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details"? } }`. Every endpoint is rate limited (`x-rate-limit` below, with `RateLimit-*` headers on each response), and each client address also gets 600 requests per 60 s across the whole API before its credentials are checked.

tags.name: Feeds
tags.description: What the player calls, from the browser.

get.summary: Get a page of a feed
get.description: Ready videos for the player, with HLS URLs. Call it from the browser with a publishable key (from one of the project's allowed origins). Pages are cached for 10 seconds per server.

400.description: The request is invalid; `details` lists each problem.

403.description: This kind of credential may not call this, or the origin is not allowed.

post.description: Batched quality metrics from the player SDK: time to first frame, rebuffers, watch time, quality switches and errors. The SDK sends these for you. The key may also go in `?key=`, because a request sent as the page unloads cannot set headers.

post.description: A viewer reports a video. Each address counts once per video (stored only as an HMAC). Three reports hide the video from feeds until it is reviewed in the dashboard.

post.description: Creates the video and a multipart upload in storage, and returns an upload token for the browser. Call it from your server. The video bytes never pass through the API: the browser sends them straight to storage (`@reelplane/sdk-core`'s `uploadVideo` does all of it).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe: the same key and body within 24 hours replay the first response (marked `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with another body is a 409.

400.description: The request is invalid; `details` lists each problem.

403.description: This kind of credential may not call this, or the origin is not allowed.

post.description: Presigned URLs for the parts still to upload, each bound to its exact size, plus the parts storage already has. Call it again to resume after a dropped connection.

400.description: The request is invalid; `details` lists each problem.

post.description: Assembles the parts, checks the file really is a video (magic bytes), and queues it for transcoding. Calling it again returns the already-queued video. A file that was rejected answers 409.

delete.description: Deletes a video at any stage: it leaves feeds at once, a queued job is cancelled, `video.deleted` is sent to webhooks, and the worker removes its files shortly after. Deleting it again answers 404.

get.description: Liveness and database reachability. No credentials; limited per address.

placeholder.description: A tiny blurred JPEG as a data: URI.

playback.description: Set once the video is ready.

hlsUrl.description: Master playlist starting at 720p (or the best rung below).

hlsLowStartUrl.description: The same renditions, starting at the lowest.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null at the end.

token.description: Upload token for the browser: works only for this video.

publishableKeyQuery.name: key
publishableKeyQuery.description: The publishable key as `?key=`, for requests sent as a page unloads.

secretKey.description: A secret key (`rp_sk_…`). Server-side only: it can manage every video.

publishableKey.description: A publishable key (`rp_pk_…`). Safe in a browser, and only accepted from the project's allowed origins.

uploadToken.description: The upload token from `POST /v1/uploads`. Works only for that one video.
